info.name: OIDC Claim Mapping
info.summary: Map OIDC token claims to Nextcloud user attributes with a visual rule editor
info.description:
Map OIDC token claims to scalar Nextcloud user attributes (display name, email, quota, country, language, etc.) using configurable rules. Hook into the user_oidc app's `AttributeMappedEvent` so any rule can override the value computed natively by user_oidc.
**Admin UI** — visual rule editor with target dropdown, raw JSON editor, and claim simulator. **Multiple rule types** — direct, prefix, map, conditional, template (full Mustache). **Per-provider scope** — bind a rule to one OIDC provider via the `iss` claim, or `*` to apply globally. **REST API** — manage rules programmatically via OCS endpoints. **OCC commands** — list, set, and test rules from the CLI. **Dark mode** — full support for Nextcloud dark and light themes.
Works with any identity provider through the user_oidc app. Requires user_oidc to be installed and enabled.
V1 targets only scalar user attributes (no groups). The group mapping path remains in the companion app oidc_groups_mapping. Future major versions may merge both surfaces.
info.author: Pierre Strobel
